ev.q: During 2009–2012, an estimated 65.5% of adults with diabetes were obese, 25.0% were overweight, and 9.5% were normal weight.

The prevalence of obesity among women with diabetes (75.3%) was higher than the prevalence of obesity among men with diabetes (58.1%).
Estimates are age-adjusted to year 2000 U.S. Census standard population using age groups 20–39 years, 40–59 years, and ≥60 years.
National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey Data.
